about: Voice order E2E on /demo with real Gemini Live (e2e/voice.live.spec.ts, `npm run test:e2e:live`). Synthetic TTS voice (Gemini TTS, e2e/fixtures) through Chromium's fake microphone on a laptop, not a real phone. End of speech = the last voiced 40 ms mic frame sent to Live before the model's first output; the page sends the looping fixture once. (a) end of speech → first AI audio chunk; (b) end of speech → first 2 s highlight ring on the kiosk half. Medians over passing runs.
